title: Gratuitous pool.clone() throughout codebase
description: api.rs, interactions.rs, posting.rs, and others. Many handler functions clone the fieldwork_db::db::Pool (let fwp = state.pool.clone()) then immediately pass it by reference, or assign let fwp = pool and never actually need the clone. Examples: api.rs:407 (let fwp = state.pool.clone() then used as &fwp), interactions.rs:32-33 (let fwp = pool then used as &fwp — not even a clone, just a rebinding), api.rs:171-172 (let fwp = pool then &fwp). Pool is Arc-wrapped internally, so cloning is cheap, but the rebinding-without-cloning pattern (let fwp = pool; ... &fwp) adds confusion about ownership semantics without achieving anything.
